assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
Diagnosis code I47.1 (supraventricular tachycardia) is present
Diagnosis code I25.10 (atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery) is present

The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
